name: table
title: Table
description: Responsive HTML table primitives with condensed tabular numeric columns and hoverable rows.
docs: Set numeric on TableHead and TableCell to right-align metrics and render cell numerals in the condensed tabular font. Mark selected rows with data-state="selected".

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { TableHeaderPart } from './parts'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {

})

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { TableHeadPart } from './parts'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type TableHeadProps = {
  /** Aligns the column header to the right for numeric values. */
  numeric?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<TableHeadProps>(), {
  numeric: false,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <TableHeadPart
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="
      cn(
        'h-10 px-3 text-left align-middle text-[12px] font-medium text-ink-muted [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0',
        numeric && 'text-right',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
  >
    <slot />
  </TableHeadPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { TableCellPart } from './parts'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type TableCellProps = {
  /** Right-aligns the cell and renders numerals in the condensed tabular font. */
  numeric?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<TableCellProps>(), {
  numeric: false,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <TableCellPart
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="
      cn(
        'p-3 align-middle [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0',
        numeric &&
          'text-right font-condensed text-[15px] font-medium tracking-[-0.01em] tabular-nums',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
  >
    <slot />
  </TableCellPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">

    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('mt-3 text-[12px] text-ink-faint', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
  >
    <slot />
  </TableCaptionPart>
</template>

import { definePrimitive } from '@ui-sdk/core'
import { createParts } from '@ui-sdk/vue/primitive'

const table = definePrimitive({
  name: 'p0seid0n-table',
  state: () => ({}),
  api: () => ({}),
  slots: (slot) => ({
    root: slot({}),
    header: slot({}),
    body: slot({}),
    footer: slot({}),
    row: slot({}),
    head: slot({}),
    cell: slot({}),
    caption: slot({}),
  }),
})

export const {
  Root: TablePart,
  Header: TableHeaderPart,
  Body: TableBodyPart,
  Footer: TableFooterPart,
  Row: TableRowPart,
  Head: TableHeadPart,
  Cell: TableCellPart,
  Caption: TableCaptionPart,
} = createParts(table, {
  root: 'table',
  header: 'thead',
  body: 'tbody',
  footer: 'tfoot',
  row: 'tr',
  head: 'th',
  cell: 'td',
  caption: 'caption',
})

export { default as Table } from './Table.vue'
export { default as TableHeader } from './TableHeader.vue'
export { default as TableBody } from './TableBody.vue'
export { default as TableFooter } from './TableFooter.vue'
export { default as TableRow } from './TableRow.vue'
export { default as TableHead } from './TableHead.vue'
export { default as TableCell } from './TableCell.vue'
export { default as TableCaption } from './TableCaption.vue'

export type { TableHeadProps } from './TableHead.vue'
export type { TableCellProps } from './TableCell.vue'
